name: Self-Healing Web App - Uptime Monitor + AI Diagnosis + GitHub PR

parameters.content:
## Self-Healing Web App (Uptime -> AI Diagnosis -> GitHub PR)

A scheduled health check polls the app's endpoints. On a failure (down, timeout, 5xx), the workflow gathers diagnostic context — the failing response, recent GitHub commits/deploys, and relevant source files — and asks Claude to (1) determine the likely root cause and (2) propose a concrete code fix as a unified diff. n8n then creates a branch, commits the AI's proposed patch, and opens a GitHub Pull Request tagged for human review, plus posts an incident summary to Slack/email. Nothing is auto-merged or auto-deployed — a human always approves the fix. An optional final stage re-checks health after the PR is merged and closes the incident.

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: GitHub API (repo read/write + PR), Anthropic API (header auth), Slack/Email (optional, for alerts)
3. Edit Set - Config: healthCheckUrl, expectedStatusCode, githubOwner, githubRepo, githubBaseBranch, maxDiagnosticFilesToFetch
4. Set the Schedule Trigger interval (e.g. every 2-5 minutes) to match your desired detection speed
5. Activate the workflow

### Requirements
- A public health-check endpoint on the target app (e.g. /health or /)
- GitHub API access to the app's repo (read source, create branch, commit, open PR)
- Anthropic API access (Claude) for root-cause analysis and patch generation
- (Optional) Slack/Email credential for incident notifications

### How to customize
- Add Sentry/log-based triggers alongside the uptime check for richer diagnostics
- Widen the file-fetch step to pull more of the repo when the stack trace points outside the obvious files
- Add a staging-deploy + automated smoke-test step before the PR is opened, so the PR description includes 'fix verified in staging'
- Swap 'open PR only' for 'auto-merge if CI passes and diff is small' once you trust the pipeline

## 1. Health Check & Failure Detection

Schedule Trigger - Poll Health fires on an interval (e.g. every 2 minutes).

Set - Config centralizes the health-check URL, expected status code, GitHub repo details, and diagnostic limits.

HTTP Request - Check App Health hits the health endpoint and captures status code, response time, and body (continueOnFail so a timeout/5xx doesn't stop the workflow).

JS - Evaluate Health Result decides healthy vs unhealthy (wrong status code, timeout, or error body) and normalizes the failure details.

IF - Is Unhealthy stops the workflow here (via NoOp) when healthy, and proceeds to incident handling when not.

## 2. Diagnostic Context Gathering

HTTP Request - GitHub: Get Recent Commits pulls the last commits on the base branch, since a recent deploy is the most likely cause of a fresh outage.

HTTP Request - GitHub: Get Recent Workflow Runs (CI/CD) pulls the latest Actions runs to see if a deploy failed or a build broke.

JS - Identify Likely Changed Files inspects the commit diffs' file lists and picks the most likely-relevant files (capped at maxDiagnosticFilesToFetch) for Claude to inspect.

HTTP Request - GitHub: Fetch File Contents retrieves the current content of those files so Claude has real source to work from, not just guesses.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - AI Root Cause + Fix

parameters.content:
## 3. AI Root Cause Analysis & Patch Generation

HTTP Request - Claude: Diagnose & Propose Fix sends the health-check failure, recent commits, CI run status, and file contents, and asks Claude for a structured diagnosis plus a concrete patch (per-file full replacement content, since that's easiest to apply reliably via the GitHub API) and a human-readable PR description.

JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch safely parses the response into a diagnosis object and a list of {path, newContent} file changes.

## 4. Branch, Commit, Pull Request & Alert

HTTP Request - GitHub: Get Base Branch SHA reads the current tip commit of the base branch.

HTTP Request - GitHub: Create Fix Branch creates a new branch (fix/self-heal-{timestamp}) from that SHA.

Split Out - Each File Change iterates the proposed file changes.

HTTP Request - GitHub: Commit File Change updates each file on the new branch via the Contents API (needs the file's current sha, fetched alongside content earlier).

HTTP Request - GitHub: Open Pull Request opens a PR from the fix branch into the base branch, titled with the diagnosis summary and labeled 'self-healing' + 'needs-review', with the AI's diagnosis and proposed reasoning in the PR body.

HTTP Request - Notify Slack/Email posts an incident summary (what broke, likely cause, PR link) so a human is looped in immediately even though nothing auto-merges.

An optional Wait + re-check branch (Wait - For Merge -> HTTP Request - Check App Health (Post-Fix) -> IF - Healed) can be appended after merge to confirm the incident is resolved and close the loop.

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('JS - Identify Likely Changed Files').first().json.githubOwner }}/{{ $('JS - Identify Likely Changed Files').first().json.githubRepo }}/contents/{{ $json.candidateFiles }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Claude: Diagnose & Propose Fix

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 4000, system: "You are a senior site-reliability engineer. Given a failing health check, recent commit history, CI status, and the current content of the most likely relevant source files, determine the most probable root cause and propose a minimal, safe code fix. Only propose changes to files you were given content for. Respond with ONLY a JSON object: { diagnosis: { rootCause: string, confidence: 'high'|'medium'|'low', evidence: string }, prTitle: string, prDescription: string, fileChanges: [ { path: string, newContent: string, changeSummary: string } ] }. If you cannot confidently diagnose from the given context, return an empty fileChanges array and explain what additional information is needed in prDescription.", messages: [ { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify({ healthCheckUrl: $json.healthCheckUrl, observedStatusCode: $json.observedStatusCode, healthCheckError: $json.healthCheckError, responseBodySnippet: $json.responseBodySnippet, recentCommitMessages: $json.recentCommitMessages, latestCiRunConclusion: $json.latestCiRunConclusion, ciFailed: $json.ciFailed, files: $json.fetchedFiles }, null, 2) } ] }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request - GitHub: Get Base Branch SHA
HTTP Request - GitHub: Create Fix Branch

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.githubOwner }}/{{ $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.githubRepo }}/git/refs

nodes.name: HTTP Request - GitHub: Commit File Change

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.githubOwner }}/{{ $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.githubRepo }}/contents/{{ $json.fileChanges.path }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: 'Self-heal: ' + $json.fileChanges.changeSummary, content: Buffer.from($json.fileChanges.newContent).toString('base64'), sha: $json.fileChanges.sha, branch: 'fix/self-heal-' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.incidentTimestamp.replace(/[:.]/g, '-') }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request - GitHub: Open Pull Request

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.githubOwner }}/{{ $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.githubRepo }}/pulls
parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ title: '[Self-Heal] ' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.prTitle, head: 'fix/self-heal-' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.incidentTimestamp.replace(/[:.]/g, '-'), base: $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.githubBaseBranch, body: '## Incident

Health check failed at ' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.incidentTimestamp + ' (status ' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.observedStatusCode + ')

## AI Root Cause Diagnosis (confidence: ' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.confidence + ')
' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.rootCause + '

Evidence: ' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.evidence + '

## Proposed Fix
' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.prDescription + '

**This PR was generated automatically and requires human review before merging.**' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ text: ':rotating_light: Self-healing incident: ' + $('JS - Parse Diagnosis & Patch').first().json.rootCause + '\nPR opened for review: ' + ($json.html_url || 'see GitHub') }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Notify: No Confident Fix

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ text: ':rotating_light: Outage detected, AI could not confidently propose a fix.
Root cause guess: ' + $json.rootCause + '
Details: ' + $json.prDescription + '
Manual investigation needed.' }) }}
